description: Real-time options analytics MCP server. 23 tools covering gamma/delta/vanna/charm exposure (GEX/DEX/VEX/CHEX), dealer positioning, 0DTE analytics, volatility surfaces, SVI parametrization, arbitrage detection, variance swaps, VRP dashboard, Black-Scholes greeks, IV solver, Kelly criterion sizing, option quotes, historical tick data, and key options levels for US equities. Streamable HTTP transport, API key auth.
